domain_rationale: Minimal generated lawful domain with explicit full state, action space, deterministic exogenous shocks, learner-visible observations, audit-only collapse predicate, one spread-like collapse mechanism, and one mass-like collapse mechanism. It exists only to test CL0 boundary fidelity and non-vacuity.
state_space_description: Exhaustive finite state set: four zone-health coordinates in {0,1,2,3,4}, global mass in {0,1,2,3,4,5,6}, and phase in {0,1,2,3}. Total states: 5^4 * 7 * 4 = 17500.
transition_semantics: state_t+1 = transition(state_t, action_t, exogenous_t). Exogenous_t is phase-indexed zone shock. AID_i increases zone i and costs mass; CONSERVE restores mass; shock damages the phase zone; failed zones drain mass; phase advances modulo 4.
collapse_predicate: Collapse if at least two zones have health <= 0 (spread mechanism) or if mass <= 0 (mass mechanism). The predicate is audit-only.
learner_visible_observation: zones, mass, phase. No collapse labels, future outcomes, collapse mechanism labels, or reporting-only metrics are learner-visible.
boundary_rule: Candidate boundary performs bounded rollout for the pre-registered horizon under a deterministic safety policy using layer-eligible coordinates zones, mass, and phase. SAFE means no collapse within horizon under that rule. Projection-blind baseline uses mean zone health only and omits failed-zone spread and mass. Trivially-safe baseline labels all states DOOMED.

metrics.false_safe_rate: P(full collapse within horizon | boundary says SAFE)
metrics.already_collapsed_labeled_safe_rate: P(boundary says SAFE | state is already collapsed)
metrics.false_positive_rate: P(boundary says DOOMED | full trajectory remains SAFE)
metrics.equal_volume_possible: Whether shielded and unfiltered control ledgers can be sampled with equal transition count under the declared minimum volume

downstream_halt_rule: No learner training, no LLM scaling, and no derivability claim unless decision is BOUNDARY-FIDELITY-OK.
provenance_attestation: This preregistration file was written before final CL1 metric computation. Thresholds must not be moved after seeing results.
